body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Barcelona, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Fundació Joan Miró, Parc de Montjuïc, s/n, Sants-Montjuïc, 08038 Barcelona, Spain. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio walking tour explores Montjuïc Park, the hillside where Barcelona brings together art, gardens, monuments, Olympic history, and sweeping city views. Your route begins at the Joan Miró Foundation, with your skip-the-line entrance ticket included within the app. Please note that the audio tour inside the museum is not provided within this bundle.
>
> After you visit the museum, unpause the tour and follow a route through Montjuïc Park, the Greek Theater, Laribal Gardens, and the grounds near Albéniz Palace, then continue into the Olympic zone with the sports museum, botanical garden, stadium, Palau Sant Jordi, and the striking communications tower. The walk then leads past quieter corners and grand cultural landmarks, including the Historic Botanical Garden, the National Art Museum of Catalonia, the Magic Fountain, the Venetian Towers, and finally Plaça d'Espanya.
>
> Along the way, you will discover how the 1929 International Exposition and the 1992 Olympic Games reshaped this hill into one of Barcelona’s most symbolic landscapes. The most memorable moments include Miró’s light-filled museum, hidden garden terraces with water and shade, the dramatic Olympic skyline, the palace-like silhouette of the Palau Nacional, and the long ceremonial descent toward Plaça d'Espanya.
